findings.title: js-yaml 4.3.1 has high-severity ReDoS vulnerability (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh)
findings.detail: frontend/package-lock.json pins js-yaml at 4.3.1 (dev transitive dep). CVE range >=4.0.0 <4.3.2: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources (CVSS 7.5). Fix: bump to 4.3.2 via npm audit fix in frontend/.
findings.suggested_fix: cd frontend && npm install && npm audit fix

findings.title: wrangler/miniflare pulls in sharp <0.35.4 with heap-buffer-overflow (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c)
findings.detail: worker/package-lock.json: wrangler >= 4.16.0 bundles miniflare which bundles sharp <0.35.4 (libheif heap-buffer-overflow, high severity). npm audit reports the fix version as wrangler 4.15.2, which is a downgrade — unsafe to apply automatically. Recommend monitoring for a wrangler patch that upgrades the bundled sharp to >=0.35.4.
findings.suggested_fix: Monitor wrangler releases for a build that bundles sharp >=0.35.4; do not downgrade wrangler

findings.title: React 18.2.0 → 19.3.0 (major version behind)
findings.detail: frontend/package.json specifies react and react-dom ^18.2.0; latest is 19.3.0. Major version bump requires manual migration (new JSX transform, Concurrent Features API changes). Not suitable for automated fix.
findings.suggested_fix: Manually upgrade react and react-dom to ^19 following the React 19 migration guide
